case.summary: This case was triggered by customer C09988 reporting an unauthorized online purchase of $59.67 on card C09988-K1, stating they never made the transaction. The graph analysis revealed a peer device connection involving 3 other cards that made near-identical purchases within 48 hours on the same device profile, scoring as likely fraud. The verdict is confirmed fraud with a final fraud probability of 0.99, supported by the customer report and case-memory models. Consequently, the card block and file report actions are recommended and pending approval, while the case creation and connected cards monitoring actions were executed automatically.
